cases.sentence: Первоначальная линия расположения ___, по Колоче, была переломлена и часть этой линии, именно левый фланг русских, вследствие взятия Шевардинского редута 24-го числа, была отнесена назад.
cases.explain: «русских войск» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The original line of the Russian forces along the river Kolochá had been dislocated by the capture of the Shevárdino Redoubt on the twenty-fourth, and part of the line—the left flank—had been drawn back. That part of the line was not entrenched and in front of it the ground was more open and level than elsewhere. It was evident to anyone, military or not, that it was here the French should attack. It would seem that not much consideration was needed to reach this conclusion, nor any particular care or trouble on the part of the Emperor and his marshals, nor was there any need of that special and supreme quality called genius that people are so apt to ascribe to Napoleon; yet the historians who described the event later and the men who then surrounded Napoleon, and he himself, thought otherwise.

cases.sentence: Выслушав предложение Даву, называемого герцогом Экмюльским, о том, чтоб обойти ___ русских, Наполеон сказал, что этого не нужно делать, не объясняя, почему этого не нужно было делать.
cases.explain: «левый фланг» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Napoleon rode over the plain and surveyed the locality with a profound air and in silence, nodded with approval or shook his head dubiously, and without communicating to the generals around him the profound course of ideas which guided his decisions merely gave them his final conclusions in the form of commands. Having listened to a suggestion from Davout, who was now called Prince d’Eckmühl, to turn the Russian left wing, Napoleon said it should not be done, without explaining why not. To a proposal made by General Campan (who was to attack the flèches) to lead his division through the woods, Napoleon agreed, though the so-called Duke of Elchingen (Ney) ventured to remark that a movement through the woods was dangerous and might disorder the division.

cases.sentence: Диспозиция эта, про которую с восторгом говорят ___, и с глубоким уважением другие историки, была следующая:
cases.explain: «французские историки» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: These dispositions, of which the French historians write with enthusiasm and other historians with profound respect, were as follows:

cases.sentence: «Генерал Сорбье должен быть готов, по ___, вынестись со всеми гаубицами гвардейской артиллерии против одного, либо другого укрепления.
cases.explain: «первому приказанию» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: General Sorbier must be ready at the first order to advance with all the howitzers of the Guard’s artillery against either one or other of the entrenchments.

cases.sentence: «Генерал Компан двинется через лес, чтоб овладеть ___.
cases.explain: «первым укреплением» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: General Campan will move through the wood to seize the first fortification.

cases.sentence: «Канонада на ___ начнется, как только будет услышана канонада правого крыла.
cases.explain: «левом фланге» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The cannonade on the left flank will begin as soon as the guns of the right wing are heard. The sharpshooters of Morand’s division and of the vice-King’s division will open a heavy fire on seeing the attack commence on the right wing.

cases.sentence: Стрелки дивизии Морана и дивизии вице-короля откроют ___, увидя начало атаки правого крыла.
cases.explain: «сильный огонь» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: The cannonade on the left flank will begin as soon as the guns of the right wing are heard. The sharpshooters of Morand’s division and of the vice-King’s division will open a heavy fire on seeing the attack commence on the right wing.

cases.explain: «императорском лагере» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The Imperial Camp near Mozháysk, September, 6, 1812.

cases.sentence: Диспозиция эта, весьма неясно и спутанно написанная, — ежели позволить себе без ___ к гениальности Наполеона относиться к распоряжениям его, — заключала в себе четыре пункта — четыре распоряжения.
cases.explain: «религиозного ужаса» — after the preposition «без», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: These dispositions, which are very obscure and confused if one allows oneself to regard the arrangements without religious awe of his genius, related to Napoleon’s orders to deal with four points—four different orders. Not one of these was, or could be, carried out.

cases.sentence: В диспозиции сказано, первое, чтоб устроенные на выбранном Наполеоном месте батареи с имеющими выравняться с ними орудиями Пернетти и Фуше, всего 102 орудия, открыли огонь и засыпали ___ и редуты снарядами.
cases.explain: «русские флеши» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In the disposition it is said first that the batteries placed on the spot chosen by Napoleon, with the guns of Pernetti and Fouché; which were to come in line with them, 102 guns in all, were to open fire and shower shells on the Russian flèches and redoubts. This could not be done, as from the spots selected by Napoleon the projectiles did not carry to the Russian works, and those 102 guns shot into the air until the nearest commander, contrary to Napoleon’s instructions, moved them forward.
